thesisQuality.note: Strong global agribusiness demand relevance and expanded network support a strong band, tempered by commodity economics and unproven normalized post-merger returns.

financialOperatingMomentum.note: Adjusted EPS improved to $2.00 from $1.31 and full-year guidance was raised; integration and commodity volatility prevent exceptional treatment.

marketValuationOpportunity.note: Current market cap is about $22.20B and shares have risen roughly 45% year over year; without a source-addressed normalized valuation bridge, opportunity remains mixed/unproven rather than assumed favorable.

catalystScore.note: Raised 2026 EPS guidance and ongoing Viterra integration/synergy realization are identifiable material catalysts, but realization timing and normalized economics retain uncertainty.

governancePower.note: Completion of the $2B Viterra-related repurchase program demonstrates capital-allocation execution, but current evidence does not establish exceptional long-duration stewardship.

alignment2036.note: Origination, processing and merchandising directly serve durable food/feed/fuel supply needs across global trade flows; relevance is strong but not irreplaceable.

crossDivisionLeverage.note: Expanded post-Viterra origination, storage, processing and merchandising footprint creates several demand/routing channels using common agricultural infrastructure.

bottleneckControl.note: Network density provides meaningful routing optionality, but evidence explicitly indicates processing/merchandising capacity is substitutable across global agribusiness peers.

scenarioRobustness.note: Global network breadth supports resilience across shifting trade flows, while crop, policy and crush-margin sensitivity prevents a higher band.

substitutionResilience.note: Scale and network breadth create moderate replacement friction, but peer processing and merchandising capacity remains a credible substitute.

supplyChainResilience.note: Expanded geographic origination/processing network supplies practical routing diversity, with climate/crop/geopolitical dependencies still material.

pricingPower.note: Improved earnings and guidance support current economics, but commodity/crush-margin exposure prevents treating pricing power as durable across cycles.

risk.note: Material but non-terminal risks are commodity-margin cyclicality, crop/policy/trade volatility and post-Viterra integration/return uncertainty.

confidence.note: Identity and primary operating evidence are current and lineage-valid, plus independent current market context; confidence is reduced because most operating assertions share one issuer origin and normalized post-integration returns remain unknown.

thesis: Bunge's expanded global agricultural network is a durable food/feed/fuel routing capability with improving current execution, but value capture remains cyclical and post-Viterra normalized returns are not yet proven.
keyRisk: Commodity-cycle volatility and integration complexity prevent network scale from automatically becoming durable scarcity rent or superior normalized returns.
nextCatalyst: Evidence of full-year 2026 execution against raised EPS guidance and measurable Viterra synergy/leverage normalization.

scoreBreakdown.note: earthScore records the methodology-weighted component score; risk and confidence are separately source-addressed and remain subject to canonical runtime gate treatment.
